name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the Excel add-in or its website
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

## Problem or task
What are you trying to accomplish in Excel or on the website? Describe the
current difficulty and who would benefit from the improvement.

## Proposed solution
Describe the behavior you would like, including the relevant add-in command or
website page if applicable.

## Example
If applicable, show a small example of the input and the expected result, or
attach a sample workbook or screenshot. Remove sensitive information: issues
and attachments are public.

## Alternatives and additional context
How do you solve this today? Describe any alternatives or limitations you have
considered. Before submitting, please check existing issues and comment there
if the same idea has already been proposed.
